import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import SpectralClustering
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify highly associated features
    strong_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) 
                      if abs(feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)].mean() * feats.y.mean()) > 0.3]
    
    # If no strong features, return empty design
    if not strong_features:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster correlated features
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in strong_features]].T)
    np.fill_diagonal(corr_matrix, 0)
    
    # Find clusters of highly correlated features
    clustering = SpectralClustering(n_clusters=min(3, len(strong_features)), 
                                   affinity='precomputed', 
                                   assign_labels='kmeans')
    cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(np.abs(corr_matrix))
    
    # Select best cluster by variance explained
    best_cluster = max(set(cluster_labels), key=lambda c: np.var([feats.column(fid) 
                                                                 for i, fid in enumerate(strong_features) 
                                                                 if cluster_labels[i] == c]))
    
    # Get features in best cluster
    cluster_features = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(strong_features) 
                       if cluster_labels[i] == best_cluster]
    
    # Compute weighted score using PCA-like approach
    if len(cluster_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Weight by effect size
    weights = np.array([abs(np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid)]) - 
                          np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid)])) 
                       for fid in cluster_features])
    weights = weights / np.sum(weights)
    
    # Return design with weighted score
    return Design(
        drivers=(cluster_features[0],),
        columns=tuple(cluster_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=dict(zip(cluster_features, weights))
    )
